silhouette.reason: Horns, open jaw with teeth, dorsal spines, membrane wings with fingers and a long tail with a spade read from every view; the spade now reads in TOP and 3/4 REAR.
fixes: lift the tail tip in the idle pose so the spade also reads in hero.png

proportions.reason: Neck reads short and thick for the 8.9 m body, and the tail root is thinner than the hips in SIDE.
fixes: lengthen the neck chain by one vertebra (neck.ts); thicken the tail root to match the hips (tail.ts)

materials.reason: A scale pattern now covers the back, flanks and neck instead of one decal patch, and eyes/teeth separate; but the scales are large round orange spots that read as leopard/blister spots, not overlapping scales.
fixes: overlapping scale shapes (rows of rounded plates with a darker gap) instead of round spots

detail.reason: Teeth, spines, wing fingers, claws and belly plates hold; the spot pattern now covers the trunk, but there is no relief between the spots.
fixes: shallow relief on the scale rows on the neck and back

wear.reason: Ragged membrane edges, a sooty dark snout and pale scars on the shoulder now show; the shoulder scars read as exposed white ribs and the horn tips are intact.
fixes: scars as short diagonal raised marks, not parallel white rib-like stripes

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps wings, horns and colour blocks; the body faceting and a lighter flank patch show at the switch.
fixes: more rings on the LOD2 tail and neck; average the colour per face

technical.reason: QA clean; 149k / 28k / 4k triangles over 7 draws: LOD0 is heavier than the detail it shows.
fixes: cap LOD0 near 120k by coarsening the hidden belly and inner-leg sculpt cells
